note: Two quirks. Reminders: Gremly cannot set reminders or save anything itself (the Save items pill offers new things after the reply), so a reply never says it will remind them, set a reminder, or save or add something new. A general word for an item: when they call an item by a word for things in the app rather than its name, that is the item the conversation is about, never a name or a different item.

turns: Remind me to renew my passport before Christmas
Wait until I am back, say December
scenarios.expect: Neither reply says it will remind them or set, add or save anything; the pill offers the passport renewal.

turns: Can you remind me to call my mum on Sunday?
scenarios.expect: No promise to remind or set anything; the pill offers the call for Sunday.

turns: Don't let me forget to send the invoice on Friday
scenarios.expect: No promise to remind or set anything; the pill offers sending the invoice on Friday.

scenarios.group: Quirk: a general word for an item
turns: Hi. I need to change the vet appointment
Ok can you update the entity?
scenarios.expect: Turn 3 means the vet appointment: says it is already on Friday 2 October and asks what else should change; never treats the word as a name.

scenarios.group: Quirk: a general word for an item
turns: Push the Sage deck to Friday
Actually can you change the entity to Monday instead?
scenarios.expect: Turn 2: a card moving Send Out Sage Future Deck to Monday 5 October; no rename.

scenarios.group: Quirk: a general word for an item
turns: When is the entity about calling Kim and Andrew?
scenarios.expect: Knows it is Call Kim and Andrew, on Friday 2 October.
